defCn: 容器标准输出与标准错误被运行时收集后可查询的文本流。

defCn: 更新期间可超出期望副本数的最大额外 Pod 数量。

defCn: 更新期间允许不可用的 Pod 数量上限（占期望副本的比例或绝对值）。

defCn: 附加在对象上的键值对，用于选择、分组与筛选工作负载。

defCn: 对象的非标识性元数据，不参与选择，只承载说明与外部配置。

exampleSentences: Annotations carry the commit SHA so we can trace a pod back to a build.

defCn: 基于标签匹配一组对象的表达式，用于控制器与服务发现。
defEn: An expression matching objects by label, used by controllers and service discovery.

exampleSentences: A wrong label selector silently produces an empty endpoint list.

defCn: Pod 上要求节点必须带有的标签集合，用于简单硬性选点。

defCn: 删除前必须由控制器清空的字符串列表，防止资源被误删。

exampleSentences: A finalizer lets our operator delete cloud resources before the Kubernetes object goes away.

defCn: 指向属主对象的引用，属主删除时被引用对象会被垃圾回收。

metadata:

defCn: 控制器依据属主引用与 finalizer 自动清理子对象的过程。
defEn: Automatic cleanup of dependent objects driven by owner references and finalizers.

defCn: 对象被标记删除的时间戳，非空表示对象正在终止中。

defCn: API 对象单调递增的版本号，用于乐观并发与监听续接。

exampleSentence: Comparing resourceVersion is how controllers avoid writing over a newer state.
exampleSentences: Comparing resourceVersion is how controllers avoid writing over a newer state.

defCn: 由 API 服务器完成字段合并的声明式写入方式，避免客户端覆盖他人配置。

exampleSentences: Server-side apply finally lets several teams share one manifest safely.

defCn: 按资源内置合并策略合并部分字段的补丁类型，可精确指定要删除的键。

defCn: RFC 7386 定义的简单补丁格式，null 表示删除键，列表整体替换。

exampleSentences: A JSON merge patch behaves predictably on custom resources with no merge strategy.

defCn: 对单个对象做局部更新而无需提交完整清单的命令。

defCn: 控制器保留的历史修订列表，可查看镜像与配置变更。

exampleSentences: Rollout history told us exactly which revision introduced the error rate jump.

defCn: 查询更新进度的子命令，可观察就绪副本与更新时间。
defEn: A subcommand reporting update progress including ready replicas and timing.

Capture rollout status into the deployment log for later review.

defCn: 持续比较期望状态与实际状态并驱动收敛的控制器设计模式。

defCn: Pod 使用的集群内身份，绑定的令牌用于调用 API 服务器。

defCn: 把角色授予命名空间内主体的关联对象。

defCn: 覆盖全部命名空间的权限角色集合，通常需显式授权才生效。

exampleSentences: A cluster role without a binding grants nothing, which is a useful review signal.

defCn: 描述如何连接集群的配置文件，含上下文、集群与用户凭据。

defCn: 为命名空间中未声明的资源请求与上限提供默认值的对象。

defCn: 限制自愿中断时最多可驱逐多少 Pod 的策略对象。

defCn: 在调度失败时自动增删云上节点的组件。

exampleSentences: An HPA on CPU reacts late for queue-driven services, so we scale on a queue depth metric.

defCn: 根据历史用量为 Pod 推荐或自动调整 CPU 与内存请求的对象。

Default autoscaling behavior scales up one pod every fifteen seconds.
We raised the scale-up policy to four pods per thirty seconds.
Autoscaling behavior cannot compensate for an inaccurate CPU request.

defCn: kubelet 因资源不足主动终止 Pod 的行为，并触发重调度。
defEn: A kubelet terminating a pod because the node lacks resources, which triggers rescheduling.
codeExample:
kubectl describe pod api-7d9 | grep -A2 Events
# Warning Evicted  The node was low on resource: memory.
exampleSentence: Eviction, not a crash, was the top cause of pod restarts that month.
exampleSentences: Eviction, not a crash, was the top cause of pod restarts that month.
The kubelet evicts pods in quality order when memory pressure hits.
Overcommitted nodes lead to a cascade of evictions and noisy neighbours.
Eviction events are the first thing to check when a pod disappears unexpectedly.

defCn: 高优先级 Pod 抢占低优先级 Pod 资源并将其驱逐的调度行为。
defEn: Scheduling behaviour where a higher-priority pod evicts lower-priority pods to get resources.
codeExample:
spec:
  priorityClassName: platform-critical
  priority: 1000
  preemptionPolicy: PreemptLowerPriority
exampleSentence: Preemption protects the control plane workload when the cluster fills up.
exampleSentences: Preemption protects the control plane workload when the cluster fills up.
Preemption is unfair but predictable: higher priority always wins.
A preemptionPolicy of Never keeps batch jobs from disturbing production.
We set priorities so a latency-sensitive tier never loses its place.

defCn: 节点因磁盘、内存或镜像压力进入驱逐状态的现象。
defEn: A node condition indicating that disk, memory or image pressure forces evictions.
codeExample:
kubectl describe node ip-10-0-3-21 | grep -A6 Conditions
# DiskPressure  True  KubeletHasDiskPressure
exampleSentence: Node pressure explains why a completed job pod vanished without an error.
exampleSentences: Node pressure explains why a completed job pod vanished without an error.
Disk pressure usually means someone forgot to prune images.
We alert on node pressure before it starts evicting pods.
Memory pressure differs from a pod hitting its own memory limit.

defCn: 把节点标记为不可调度的操作，防止新 Pod 调度上来。
defEn: Marking a node unschedulable so no new pods are placed on it.
codeExample:
kubectl cordon ip-10-0-3-21
kubectl get nodes
# ip-10-0-3-21   Ready,SchedulingDisabled
exampleSentence: We cordon the node first, then drain pods, so nothing new arrives mid-upgrade.
exampleSentences: We cordon the node first, then drain pods, so nothing new arrives mid-upgrade.
Cordon alone never evicts anything; a drain is required.
Automatically cordoned nodes usually indicate a cloud instance problem.
After maintenance we uncordon only when the node reports healthy again.

defCn: 按自定义规则重新评估调度并驱逐不合适的 Pod 的组件。
defEn: A component that re-evaluates placement and evicts pods that violate custom rules.
exampleSentence: A descheduler keeps utilization even after a big pod lands on a small node.
exampleSentences: A descheduler keeps utilization even after a big pod lands on a small node.
Our descheduler evicts pods only after they have run for an hour.
Low node utilization plugins need headroom to move pods safely.
Running a descheduler respects disruption budgets like everything else.

defCn: 污点的作用类型，取值 NoSchedule、PreferNoSchedule 或 NoExecute。
defEn: The behaviour attached to a taint: NoSchedule, PreferNoSchedule or NoExecute.
codeExample:
kubectl taint nodes gpu-01 dedicated=gpu:NoSchedule
# tolerations: [{key: dedicated, operator: Equal, value: gpu, effect: NoSchedule}]
exampleSentence: The taint effect decides whether a pod is forbidden or merely discouraged from the node.
exampleSentences: The taint effect decides whether a pod is forbidden or merely discouraged from the node.
NoExecute also evicts pods that are already running when the taint appears.
PreferNoSchedule is soft, so the scheduler ignores it under pressure.
A mismatched effect in the toleration means the taint still blocks the pod.

defCn: 容忍 NoExecute 污点的宽限秒数，到期后 Pod 被驱逐。
defEn: The grace period a pod tolerates a NoExecute taint before being evicted.
codeExample:
tolerations:
- key: node.kubernetes.io/unreachable
  operator: Exists
  effect: NoExecute
  tolerationSeconds: 120
exampleSentence: Long toleration seconds keep stateful pods alive during a short network partition.
exampleSentences: Long toleration seconds keep stateful pods alive during a short network partition.
A toleration with no toleration seconds tolerates forever.
Short toleration seconds make failover fast but risk double writes.
We set toleration seconds per service depending on its recovery time.

defCn: 按节点标签表达硬性或软性选点偏好的调度规则。
defEn: Scheduling rules expressing hard requirements or soft preferences on node labels.
codeExample:
affinity:
  nodeAffinity:
    requiredDuringSchedulingIgnoredDuringExecution:
      nodeSelectorTerms:
      - matchExpressions: [{key: disktype, operator: In, values: [ssd]}]
exampleSentence: Node affinity replaced our nodeSelector once we needed a soft preference for GPU nodes.
exampleSentences: Node affinity replaced our nodeSelector once we needed a soft preference for GPU nodes.
Required node affinity rules are hard, so unsatisfiable pods stay pending.
The ignored part of the rule name means node labels can change afterwards.
Pod affinity is the right tool for spreading replicas, not node affinity.

defCn: 把 Pod 调度到已有匹配 Pod 所在节点附近的亲和规则。
defEn: Affinity rules that schedule a pod near nodes already running matching pods.
exampleSentence: Pod affinity keeps a cache and its client pods on the same node to cut latency.
exampleSentences: Pod affinity keeps a cache and its client pods on the same node to cut latency.
Hard pod affinity can leave pods pending if the topology domain is too small.
We prefer anti-affinity for spreading and affinity for locality.
A wide topology key turns affinity into anti-affinity in practice.

defCn: 尽量把同组 Pod 分散到不同节点或可用区的反向亲和规则。
defEn: Anti-affinity rules that spread matching pods across different nodes or zones.
codeExample:
affinity:
  podAntiAffinity:
    preferredDuringSchedulingIgnoredDuringExecution:
    - weight: 100
      podAffinityTerm:
        topologyKey: kubernetes.io/hostname
        labelSelector: {matchLabels: {app: api}}
exampleSentence: Pod anti-affinity is how we spread each service across three zones by default.
exampleSentences: Pod anti-affinity is how we spread each service across three zones by default.
Soft pod anti-affinity is a preference, so the scheduler may still co-locate.
Hard anti-affinity leaves a pod pending when a whole zone is gone.
We encode anti-affinity in the pod template rather than per deployment.

defCn: 软性调度偏好，调度器尽量满足但不强制。
defEn: Soft scheduling preferences the scheduler tries to satisfy without enforcing them.
codeExample:
preferredDuringSchedulingIgnoredDuringExecution:
- weight: 80
  preference:
    matchExpressions: [{key: failure-domain.beta.kubernetes.io/zone, operator: In, values: [eu-west-1a]}]
exampleSentence: Preferred scheduling let us nudge pods toward cheap nodes without blocking deployment.
exampleSentences: Preferred scheduling let us nudge pods toward cheap nodes without blocking deployment.
Weights decide among several preferences when none can be fully satisfied.
Preferences are ignored when required rules already leave the scheduler no choice.
We use preferred scheduling to bias toward spot capacity during off hours.

defCn: 在每个节点上维护网络规则、把服务流量转发到后端 Pod 的组件。
defEn: The node component that maintains network rules forwarding service traffic to backend pods.
codeExample:
kubectl -n kube-system get ds kube-proxy
# iptables mode, or ipvs / nftables in newer versions
exampleSentence: kube-proxy programs the rules that make a ClusterIP service reachable on every node.
exampleSentences: kube-proxy programs the rules that make a ClusterIP service reachable on every node.
IPVS mode gives kube-proxy better handling of many endpoints.
Restarting kube-proxy briefly drops service reachability on that node.
kube-proxy in nftables mode is the default in recent Kubernetes releases.

defCn: 只在集群内部可访问的虚拟服务 IP，是 Service 的默认类型。
defEn: A virtual service IP reachable only inside the cluster and the default service type.
codeExample:
apiVersion: v1
kind: Service
spec:
  type: ClusterIP
  clusterIP: None  # headless
  ports: [{port: 80, targetPort: 8080}]
exampleSentence: A ClusterIP gets one stable address that kube-proxy maps to changing pod IPs.
exampleSentences: A ClusterIP gets one stable address that kube-proxy maps to changing pod IPs.
ClusterIP addresses are stable for the life of the service object.
Use a headless service when clients must see individual pod addresses.
Only internal traffic can reach a ClusterIP without an ingress or gateway.

defCn: 在每个节点上开放同一固定端口以暴露服务的类型。
defEn: A service type that opens the same fixed port on every node.
codeExample:
spec:
  type: NodePort
  ports: [{port: 80, targetPort: 8080, nodePort: 31080}]
exampleSentence: NodePort is the simplest way to reach a service without a cloud load balancer.
exampleSentences: NodePort is the simplest way to reach a service without a cloud load balancer.
The nodePort range is limited, so we allocate it from a registry in the repository.
NodePort traffic bypasses TLS termination, so it is rarely used in production.
A NodePort service is handy for debugging from a node's IP.

defCn: 把服务名通过 DNS CNAME 指向集群外部主机的服务类型。
defEn: A service type that maps a name to an external host via a DNS CNAME.
codeExample:
spec:
  type: ExternalName
  externalName: legacy-db.internal.example.com
  ports: [{port: 5432}]
exampleSentence: An externalName service gave us a stable in-cluster name for a legacy database.
exampleSentences: An externalName service gave us a stable in-cluster name for a legacy database.
ExternalName services are pure DNS and hold no proxying rules.
No endpoints exist, so an externalName service never reports ready endpoints.
We use it only for temporary migrations away from hard-coded hostnames.

defCn: 服务上用于匹配后端 Pod 标签的表达式，决定端点列表。
defEn: The label expression on a service that selects the backend pods forming its endpoints.
codeExample:
spec:
  selector:
    app.kubernetes.io/name: api
    app.kubernetes.io/version: "2.1"
# kubectl get endpoints api
exampleSentence: An empty endpoint list almost always means the service selector does not match the pods.
exampleSentences: An empty endpoint list almost always means the service selector does not match the pods.
Including a version label in the selector lets old and new run side by side.
Our CI checks that every service selector matches at least one pod template.
Endpoint objects are still supported although EndpointSlice is preferred.

defCn: 把同一客户端的后续请求固定到同一后端的负载均衡策略。
defEn: A load balancing policy that pins subsequent requests from one client to the same backend.
exampleSentence: Session affinity is a compatibility crutch for a client that still keeps local state.
exampleSentences: Session affinity is a compatibility crutch for a client that still keeps local state.
Sticky sessions hide the real bug, which is state left in the backend.
Session affinity breaks rebalancing because one pod gets uneven load.
We removed session affinity and fixed the in-memory cache instead.

defCn: 声明命名空间或 Pod 间允许哪些入站与出站流量的策略对象。
defEn: A policy object declaring which inbound and outbound connections are allowed.
codeExample:
kind: NetworkPolicy
spec:
  podSelector: {matchLabels: {app: api}}
  policyTypes: [Ingress]
  ingress: [{from: [{namespaceSelector: {matchLabels: {team: edge}}}]}]
exampleSentence: A default-deny NetworkPolicy plus explicit allows is the baseline we require.
exampleSentences: A default-deny NetworkPolicy plus explicit allows is the baseline we require.
Without a CNI that enforces policies, the object is accepted but ignored.
DNS egress must be allowed explicitly or every service breaks at once.
Network policies are additive, so a union of rules applies to the pod.

defCn: Ingress 上选择具体入口控制器实现的类名字段。
defEn: The field on an Ingress that selects which ingress controller handles it.
codeExample:
spec:
  ingressClassName: nginx
  rules: [{host: api.example.com, http: {paths: [{path: /, pathType: Prefix, backend: {service: {name: api, port: {number: 80}}}}]}}]
exampleSentence: Setting the ingress class lets us migrate traffic between controllers without touching routes.
exampleSentences: Setting the ingress class lets us migrate traffic between controllers without touching routes.
The default ingress class is used when the field is left empty.
We run two ingress classes for blue-green gateway migrations.
An unknown ingress class means no controller watches the object at all.

defCn: 读取 Ingress 规则并实际承担外部流量的控制器进程。
defEn: The controller process that reads Ingress rules and terminates external traffic.
codeExample:
kubectl -n ingress-nginx get deploy ingress-nginx-controller
# 2/2 Running
exampleSentence: The ingress controller is a data plane component, so its capacity matters more than its version.
exampleSentences: The ingress controller is a data plane component, so its capacity matters more than its version.
Upgrading the ingress controller reloads connections, so we do it in small steps.
Our ingress controller watches ingress objects and programs a proxy config.
Running more than one ingress class needs separate controller deployments.

defCn: 面向角色分离的新一代流量路由 API，用 GatewayClass 与 HTTPRoute 表达策略。
defEn: The next-generation routing API expressing policy through GatewayClass and HTTPRoute resources.
codeExample:
kind: HTTPRoute
spec:
  parentRefs: [{name: edge, namespace: infra}]
  rules: [{matches: [{path: {type: PathPrefix, value: /api}}], backendRefs: [{name: api, port: 8080}]}]
exampleSentence: Gateway API separates who owns the gateway from who owns the routes, which suits multi-team clusters.
exampleSentences: Gateway API separates who owns the gateway from who owns the routes, which suits multi-team clusters.
Migrating to Gateway API lets platform teams own the gateway and app teams own routes.
The Gateway API model replaces cluster-scoped annotations on the ingress.
Our edge team publishes a Gateway class with a strict policy allowlist.

defCn: Linux 内核包过滤与转发框架，kube-proxy 用它实现服务转发。
defEn: The Linux packet filtering and forwarding framework used by kube-proxy for service routing.
codeExample:
iptables -t nat -L KUBE-SERVICES -n | head
# iptables-save | grep KUBE-SVC | wc -l
exampleSentence: With thousands of endpoints the iptables rule chain becomes the slowest part of service setup.
exampleSentences: With thousands of endpoints the iptables rule chain becomes the slowest part of service setup.
Switching kube-proxy to IPVS cut rule update time from seconds to milliseconds.
iptables rules are lost on node reboot until kube-proxy programs them again.
A node with conntrack pressure drops packets before iptables can filter them.

defCn: 内核层的虚拟服务器调度器，kube-proxy 可用它替代 iptables 做负载均衡。
defEn: A kernel virtual server scheduler that kube-proxy can use instead of iptables for load balancing.
codeExample:
kube-proxy --proxy-mode=ipvs
lsmod | grep ip_vs
# ip_vs  ip_vs_rr  ip_vs_wrr  ip_vs_sh
exampleSentence: IPVS handles tens of thousands of endpoints with far less kernel overhead than iptables chains.
exampleSentences: IPVS handles tens of thousands of endpoints with far less kernel overhead than iptables chains.
IPVS scheduling algorithms include round robin, weighted round robin and least connections.
Switching to IPVS requires kernel modules on every node.
Observability was worse under IPVS, which delayed our rollout.

defCn: 容器网络接口规范，定义运行时如何为 Pod 分配与连接网络。
defEn: Container Network Interface, the specification for how runtimes give pods a network.
codeExample:
kubectl -n kube-system get ds calico-cni-plugin
# crictl inspectp my-pod | jq '.info.runtimeSpec.linux'
exampleSentence: Our CNI plugin is the component that creates the veth pair for each pod sandbox.
exampleSentences: Our CNI plugin is the component that creates the veth pair for each pod sandbox.
The CNI is the most common source of node networking surprises.
A CNI plugin runs once per pod sandbox creation and is responsible for cleanup too.
Changing CNI requires draining nodes because existing sandboxes keep old rules.

defCn: 容器存储接口规范，让任意存储后端以统一方式挂载卷。
defEn: Container Storage Interface, the specification letting any storage backend serve volumes.
codeExample:
kubectl get storageclass
# ebs-sc (kubernetes.io/aws-ebs)  Provisioner: ebs.csi.aws.com
exampleSentence: The CSI driver abstracts block and file storage so the same manifest works on any cloud.
exampleSentences: The CSI driver abstracts block and file storage so the same manifest works on any cloud.
A CSI driver needs both a controller and a node plugin pod.
Volume attachment is slow on the first mount and cached afterwards.
CSI snapshots gave us cluster-local backups without touching the application.

defCn: 实现 CSI 规范的具体存储插件，提供动态供应与挂载能力。
defEn: A concrete storage plugin implementing the CSI spec for provisioning and mounting volumes.
codeExample:
kind: CSIDriver
metadata: {name: ebs.csi.aws.com}
spec:
  attachRequired: true
  volumeLifecycleModes: [Persistent]
exampleSentence: The CSI driver translates a persistent volume claim into a real cloud disk.
exampleSentences: The CSI driver translates a persistent volume claim into a real cloud disk.
A CSI driver that only supports ephemeral mode cannot back a database claim.
We check the CSI driver version before upgrading the storage class parameters.
The CSI driver pod runs with a service account allowed to create cloud volumes.

defCn: 实现 CNI 规范的单个网络插件二进制，由运行时按 Pod 调用。
defEn: A binary implementing the CNI spec, invoked by the runtime for each pod.
exampleSentence: CNI plugins are executed as short-lived binaries, so they must be fast and stateless.
exampleSentences: CNI plugins are executed as short-lived binaries, so they must be fast and stateless.
Each CNI plugin in the chain runs in order, so one failure blocks the whole sandbox.
Debugging a CNI plugin means reading the container runtime log during pod creation.
We pinned our CNI plugin versions after an automatic upgrade broke networking.

defCn: 把本地端口隧道到 Pod 端口以便本地调试的命令。
defEn: The command tunnelling a local port to a pod port for local debugging.
exampleSentence: Port forward saved us from building a temporary staging ingress for one endpoint.
exampleSentences: Port forward saved us from building a temporary staging ingress for one endpoint.
Port forward goes through the API server, so it needs pod permission.
It bypasses ingress, TLS and service routing, which is exactly what you want sometimes.
A port forward tunnel drops whenever your laptop sleeps.

defCn: 按权重把入口流量分到不同服务版本的路由能力。
defEn: The routing capability that divides ingress traffic across service versions by weight.
exampleSentence: Traffic split percentages let us grow exposure to a new version without a flag in the app.
exampleSentences: Traffic split percentages let us grow exposure to a new version without a flag in the app.
We started at one percent traffic split and watched the error budget.
Traffic split weights must total one hundred across the routes.
Routing by header beat traffic split for our internal canary testers.

defCn: 按 URL 路径前缀把请求分发到不同后端服务的规则。
defEn: Routing rules that dispatch requests to different backends based on URL path prefix.
codeExample:
paths:
- path: /api
  pathType: Prefix
  backend: {service: {name: api, port: {number: 8080}}}
- path: /
  pathType: Prefix
  backend: {service: {name: web, port: {number: 3000}}}
exampleSentence: Path-based routing moved the legacy admin app to a separate service without a proxy rewrite.
exampleSentences: Path-based routing moved the legacy admin app to a separate service without a proxy rewrite.
Longest prefix matching decides which rule wins when two paths overlap.
Path-based routing needs a rewrite annotation when the backend path differs.
We keep path-based routing simple and put policy in the service instead.

defCn: 让 Pod 直接共享节点网络命名空间而非使用独立 Pod 网络。
defEn: Sharing the node network namespace instead of getting an isolated pod network.
exampleSentence: host networking removes the kube-proxy hop, so it suits node agents with strict latency budgets.
exampleSentences: host networking removes the kube-proxy hop, so it suits node agents with strict latency budgets.
Host networking means ports must be unique across the whole node.
A host network pod needs ClusterFirstWithHostNet to resolve cluster services.
We only allow host networking for approved node agents.

defCn: 把宿主机端口映射到容器端口的映射关系。
defEn: The mapping that exposes a container port on a host port.
codeExample:
docker run -d -p 8080:80 --name web nginx
docker port web
exampleSentence: Port mapping with a random host port avoids conflicts in local development.
exampleSentences: Port mapping with a random host port avoids conflicts in local development.
Publishing all ports with -P is convenient but makes conflicts hard to predict.
On Kubernetes the equivalent mapping lives in the container port and service fields.
Port mapping is bypassed for pods on a host network.

defCn: 容器进程监听的端口声明，用于服务发现与探针。
defEn: The declared port a container process listens on, used for discovery and probes.
exampleSentence: Naming the container port lets probes and services avoid repeating the number.
exampleSentences: Naming the container port lets probes and services avoid repeating the number.
Declaring a container port does not actually expose it outside the pod network.
We name ports so service targets read as symbols instead of magic numbers.
A container port of zero requests a random assigned port.

defCn: 把宿主机目录直接挂载进容器的挂载方式。
defEn: Mounting a host directory directly into a container.
exampleSentence: A read-only bind mount lets live-reload development stay safe.
exampleSentences: A read-only bind mount lets live-reload development stay safe.
Bind mounts bypass image layers, so changes appear instantly.
A read-only bind mount prevents the build from writing into the source tree.
On Kubernetes a bind mount becomes a hostPath volume, which we restrict by policy.

defCn: 把节点上某个目录直接暴露给 Pod 的卷类型，破坏调度可移植性。
defEn: A volume exposing a directory from the node into pods, which breaks scheduling portability.
codeExample:
volumes:
- name: logs
  hostPath: {path: /var/log/app, type: Directory}
# admission policy: forbid hostPath outside /var/log
exampleSentence: A hostPath volume ties a pod to one node, so the scheduler must place it explicitly.
exampleSentences: A hostPath volume ties a pod to one node, so the scheduler must place it explicitly.
We forbid hostPath in policy because it is a path to node escape.
A hostPath volume is convenient for collecting node logs into a sidecar.
Directory type makes kubelet create the path if it does not exist yet.

defCn: Pod 创建时生成、随 Pod 删除销毁的临时可写卷。
defEn: A writable scratch volume created with the pod and deleted when it goes away.
codeExample:
volumes:
- name: cache
  emptyDir:
    medium: Memory
    sizeLimit: 256Mi
exampleSentence: An emptyDir with memory medium is the standard place for scratch files and socket buffers.
exampleSentences: An emptyDir with memory medium is the standard place for scratch files and socket buffers.
emptyDir data counts against the node's ephemeral storage.
We cap every emptyDir size so one pod cannot fill the disk.
Contents of an emptyDir survive container restarts but not pod deletion.

defCn: 基于内存的临时文件系统，速度快但随内存占用与丢失。
defEn: An in-memory temporary file system that is fast but consumes memory and is volatile.
codeExample:
volumes:
- name: tmp
  emptyDir: {medium: Memory, sizeLimit: 512Mi}
mount -t tmpfs -o size=1G tmpfs /scratch
exampleSentence: We mount tmpfs for compiler output so scratch I/O never touches the disk.
exampleSentences: We mount tmpfs for compiler output so scratch I/O never touches the disk.
A tmpfs mount never touches disk, which removes fsync latency entirely.
tmpfs usage counts against the pod memory limit, so set a size limit.
Node agents commonly use tmpfs to avoid writing logs to disk.

defCn: 对可用存储资源的请求对象，Pod 通过它挂载持久卷。
defEn: A request for durable storage that a pod mounts to obtain a persistent volume.
exampleSentence: A persistent volume claim keeps application state out of the pod lifecycle entirely.
exampleSentences: A persistent volume claim keeps application state out of the pod lifecycle entirely.
ReadWriteOnce means one node can mount it, which is fine for a database.
The claim is what a StatefulSet references in its volume claim template.
Claims are namespaced, so the same storage cannot be claimed twice by accident.

defCn: 描述存储类型、供应器与回收策略的资源模板。
defEn: A resource template describing storage type, provisioner and reclamation policy.
exampleSentence: The storage class decides disk performance and when provisioning happens.
exampleSentences: The storage class decides disk performance and when provisioning happens.
WaitForFirstConsumer delays provisioning until a pod is scheduled, keeping volumes close by.
A Retain reclaim policy protects data when a claim is deleted.
We have three storage classes for fast, standard and archive tiers.

defCn: 随 Pod 生命周期创建与销毁、由生命周期钩子触发的通用临时卷。
defEn: Generic short-lived volumes created and destroyed by pod lifecycle hooks.
codeExample:
volumes:
- name: cache
  ephemeral:
    volumeClaimTemplate:
      spec:
        storageClassName: fast-ssd
        accessModes: [ReadWriteOnce]
exampleSentence: An ephemeral volume gives a generic API for scratch storage without older volume types.
exampleSentences: An ephemeral volume gives a generic API for scratch storage without older volume types.
Generic ephemeral volumes can be backed by any CSI driver.
An ephemeral volume is deleted when the owning pod is deleted.
We use ephemeral volumes for per-pod build caches in CI jobs.

defCn: 把多个来源（配置、密钥、下行 API）合并挂载到同一目录的卷。
defEn: A volume that merges several sources such as config, secrets and downward API into one directory.
exampleSentence: A projected volume lets us hand the process one tidy directory of configuration.
exampleSentences: A projected volume lets us hand the process one tidy directory of configuration.
Projected volumes update in place when the underlying secret rotates.
Downward API items let a pod read its own labels and limits.
We removed three volume mounts by switching to one projected volume.

defCn: 把 Pod 自身元数据注入容器内文件或环境变量的机制。
defEn: The mechanism exposing a pod's own metadata to its containers as files or env vars.
exampleSentence: The downward API lets an application log its own pod name without a service lookup.
exampleSentences: The downward API lets an application log its own pod name without a service lookup.
Downward API values are resolved by kubelet, not by the application.
We inject the pod name so a log line can be traced to an instance.
Field paths can read labels, annotations, namespace and resource limits.

defCn: StatefulSet 中为每个有序 Pod 自动创建的存储请求模板。
defEn: A template in a StatefulSet that creates one storage claim per ordinal pod.
codeExample:
spec:
  volumeClaimTemplates:
  - metadata: {name: data}
    spec:
      accessModes: [ReadWriteOnce]
      resources: {requests: {storage: 20Gi}}
# data-db-0, data-db-1
